scripts.build: cd web && npm run build && cd .. && node copyBuildToAndroid.js
scripts.android-build-apk: cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && apksigner sign --ks key.keystore --ks-key-alias micromonkey --out app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk && cd ..
scripts.web-deploy: cd web && npm run deploy && cd ..
scripts.web-deploy-beta: cd web && npm run deploy-beta && cd ..
